title: Dashboard active-work visibility
summary: Add backend-owned active-work summary fields to the snapshot current_work payload and render them across the WebView dashboard, Run Progress, Live Run, and Next 5 Videos surfaces.
reason: The dashboard could show a CSV rerun as merely active/importing even when backend progress evidence showed specific media work such as subtitle OCR, forcing operators to infer current activity from scattered log text.
behavior_before: During CSV rerun or active processing, the WebView often led with generic workflow labels such as CSV import or CSV rerun active, and Live Run could show a missing import line even when backend progress bars or events contained richer current-work evidence.
behavior_after: The backend normalizes current stage, next stage, latest evidence/event, missing evidence, blocked status, route, queue position, and item labels into current_work; the WebView displays that backend-owned summary in the banner, tiles, Run Progress, Live Run, and current queue row.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q - failed: two pre-existing static assertions outside this change expect launch/HTML strings that are absent in the current dirty worktree
rollback_plan: Revert the current_work summary field construction, snapshot wiring, WebView render/mapping changes, inventory notes, and focused tests, then refresh generated summaries for the reverted source/test files. No media or runtime state migration is required.
